ci_support_linux_64_root_base6.36.10root:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
jsoncpp:
- 1.9.7
ldas_tools_framecpp:
- '2.9'
libboost_headers:
- '1.90'
root_base:
- 6.36.10
root_cxx_standard:
- '20'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - root_base
  - root_cxx_standard
name: gds-dmt-base
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 3.0.1
  # dependencies
  gds_base_version: 3.0.1
  gds_lsmp_version: 3.0.1
  gds_frameio_version: 3.0.1
  ldas_tools_framecpp_version: 2.5.8

recipe:
  name: gds-dmt
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/gds-dmt-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a30b770452c14faf469586e4c522615cfb96454d5a1c4f34210d00afc477bffb
  patches:
    - fix-datenv-link.patch

build:
  number: 11
  skip: win

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: gds-dmt-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - autoconf
        - automake
        - gnuconfig
        - libtool
        - make
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - gds-base >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-base-gdstrig >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-base-monitors >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-frameio-base >=${{ gds_frameio_version }}
        - gds-lsmp >=${{ gds_lsmp_version }}
        - gds-services >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - jsoncpp
        - ldas-tools-al
        - ldas-tools-framecpp >=${{ ldas_tools_framecpp_version }}
        - libboost-headers
        - root_base
        - root_cxx_standard

  - package:
      name: gds-dmt-base
    inherit:
      from: gds-dmt-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - include/gds/calc_engine/
        - lib/libcalcengn.*
        - lib/pkgconfig/gdsdmtcalcengine.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("gds-dmt-base", upper_bound="x") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - gds/calc_engine/engine.hh
          lib:
            - calcengn
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" gdsdmtcalcengine
    about:
      summary: GDS DMT package Core libraries
      homepage: https://computing.docs.ligo.org/daswgweb/projects/dmt.html

  - package:
      name: gds-dmt-monitors
    inherit:
      from: gds-dmt-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - bin/DMTGen
        - include/gds/generator/
        - include/gds/osc/
        - include/gds/CalibChan.hh
        - include/gds/DMTBase.hh
        - include/gds/DMTServer.hh
        - include/gds/DatEnv.hh
        - include/gds/DynConfig.hh
        - include/gds/FDCalibrate.hh
        - include/gds/FDEasyCalibrate.hh
        - include/gds/FilterDB.hh
        - include/gds/FilterModule.hh
        - include/gds/GDSPlot.hh
        - include/gds/GridWare.hh
        - include/gds/IfoResponse.hh
        - include/gds/LscCalib.hh
        - include/gds/LscEmul.hh
        - include/gds/LscPdBackout.hh
        - include/gds/MultiStream.hh
        - include/gds/OperStateCondList.hh
        - include/gds/PSD.hh
        - include/gds/TrigEnv.hh
        - include/gds/marker.hh
        - include/gds/plot_pars.hh
        - lib/libdmtenv.*
        - lib/libezcalib.*
        - lib/libgds_plotpkg.*
        - lib/libgenerator.*
        - lib/liblscemul.*
        - lib/libosc.*
        - lib/pkgconfig/gdsdmtenv.pc
        - lib/pkgconfig/gdsdmtezcalib.pc
        - lib/pkgconfig/gdsdmtosc.pc
        - lib/pkgconfig/gdsplotpkg.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - gds-base >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - gds-base-gdstrig >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gds-dmt-base', exact=True) }}
        - gds-frameio-base >=${{ gds_frameio_version }}
        - gds-lsmp
        - gds-services >=${{ gds_base_version }}
        - jsoncpp
        - ldas-tools-al
        - ldas-tools-framecpp
        - root_base
        - root_cxx_standard
      run:
        - gds-services >=${{ gds_base_version }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("gds-dmt-monitors", upper_bound="x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - if: osx
            then: gds-lsmp
          - gds-services
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - gds/GDSPlot.hh
          lib:
            - dmtenv
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" gdsdmtenv
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" gdsdmtezcalib
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" gdsdmtosc
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" gdsplotpkg
    about:
      summary: Libraries used by DMT Monitor programs
      homepage: https://computing.docs.ligo.org/daswgweb/projects/dmt.html

  - package:
      name: gds-dmt-root
    inherit:
      from: gds-dmt-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - share/gds/macros/
        - share/gds/.rootrc
        - share/gds/root-version
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/gds/macros/rootlogon.C
    about:
      summary: Root wrapper for gds classes
      homepage: https://computing.docs.ligo.org/daswgweb/projects/dmt.html

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: LIGO Global Diagnostics System
  homepage: https://computing.docs.ligo.org/daswgweb/projects/dmt.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - emaros
